journey.name: Lift: challenges and totals
journey.description: The benchmarks under way show under the program on Lift's Today, worked out from the sets logged; a lift's page says its reps in all; the summary names a new best and a milestone crossed. Run with a bell owned.

actions.action: Start a session and log a set of 100 two-hand swings; finish it and verify that the summary says "1000 in all" only once the swings ever pass 1,000
On Lift's Today once a thousand swings are logged in four weeks, verify that under the program a "10,000 swings" row says how many in the last four weeks, with a bar

Start a session, log ten sets of 10 snatches about a minute apart, finish it, and verify that the summary says "Snatch test: 50 in 5 minutes, your best" (or as many as five minutes held), and that Today shows "Snatch test: 100 in 5 minutes" with that best
Open Exercises, then Snatch, and verify that it says its reps in all
